market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a minor PSOL politician with negligible national presence; the probability he'll finish second in the 2026 presidential race is extremely low (≈0.5%). The market's implied 6% chance is an order of magnitude too high, making a No bet clearly favorable.
evidence_points: Renan Santos was a gubernatorial candidate (Minas Gerais, 2022), not a presidential figure, showing minimal national profile.
The 2026 field will likely include heavyweight candidates (Lula, Tarcísio de Freitas, etc.) and even PSOL's potential standard-bearer would be more prominent (e.g., Guilherme Boulos).
Historical Brazilian first rounds show second place goes to major opposition candidates; a minor politician finishing runner-up is virtually unprecedented.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of Brazilian politics and 2022 election results
